sn35.240:1.1: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave kummo kacchapo sāyaṇhasamayam anunadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi ||
sn35.240:1.2: siṅgālo pi kho bhikkhave sāyaṇhasamayam anunadītīre gocarapasuto ahosi || || 4
sn35.240:1.3: Addasā kho bhikkhave kummo kacchapo siṅgālam dūrato va gocarapasutaṃ ||
sn35.240:1.4: disvāna soṇḍipañcimāni aṅgāni sake kapāle samodahitvā appossukko tuṇhībhūto saṃkasāyati || 5
sn35.240:1.5: Siṅgalo pi bhikkhave addasā kummaṃ kacchapam dūrato va ||
sn35.240:1.6: disvāna yena kummo kacchapo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā kummaṃ kacchapam paccupaṭṭhito ahosi || ||
sn35.240:1.7: Yadāyam kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcimānam aṅgānam aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgam abhininnāmessati tattheva naṃ gahetvā uddālitvā khādissāmīti || || 6
sn35.240:1.8: Yadā kho bhikkhave kummo kacchapo soṇḍipañcimānam aṅgānam aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā aṅgaṃ na abhininnāmesi || atha siṅgālo kummamhā nibbijja pakkāmi otāram alabhamāno || || 7
sn35.240:2.1: Evam eva kho bhikkhave tumhe pi Māro pāpimā satatam samitam paccupaṭṭhito
sn35.240:2.2: Appevanāmaham imesaṃ cakkhuto vā otāraṃ labheyyaṃ || pa ||
sn35.240:2.5: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave indriyesu guttadvārā viharatha || ||
sn35.240:2.6: Cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha mānuvyañjanaggahino ||
sn35.240:2.7: yatvādhikaraṇam enaṃ cakkhundriyam asaṃvutaṃ viharantam abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ || tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha || rakkhatha cakkhundriyam || cakkhundriye saṃvaram āpajjatha || ||
sn35.240:2.12: Manasā dhammaṃ viññāya mā nimittaggāhino ahuvattha mā anuvyañjanaggāhino ||
sn35.240:2.13: yatvādhikaraṇam enam manindriyam asaṃvutaṃ viharantam abhijjhā domanassā pāpakā akusalā dhammā anvāssaveyyuṃ || tassa saṃvarāya paṭipajjatha || rakkhatha manindriyam || manindriye saṃvaram āpajjatha || ||
sn35.240:2.14: Yato tumhe bhikkhave indriyesu guttadvārā viharissatha || atha tumhehi pi Māro pāpimā nibbijja pakkamissati otāram alabhamāno
